notes: Play Billing moves from version 7 to version 8. Google stops accepting version 7 for new apps and updates on 31 August 2026, so shipping on it would have meant an app that could not be updated a week later. Version 8 also reports which products the store could not return and why, so a product missing or mistyped in Play Console now says so in the log instead of showing a silent "price unavailable".
